weekend_race.race_comments: Shane Van Gisbergen won The Grant Park 165 at the Chicago Street Race, his third NASCAR Cup Series victory. Prior to the green flag to start the race, the following cars dropped to the rear for the reasons indicated: No. 11 (engine change); Nos. 4, 5, 9, 10, 23, 24, 47, 48, 78.
